scripts.lint: eslint backend/src backend/tests frontend-router/src frontend-state/src && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p backend/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p frontend-router/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p frontend-state/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend-router && npm run build --prefix frontend-state
